Dipavli se lekar chhath mahaparv tak bihar ke ganvon aur shahron men raunak dekhne ko mili. rojgar, naukri aur karobar ke silsile men dilli, munbaee, hariyana, panjab, gujrat, maharashtr, odisha aur desh ke dusre rajyon men rahne vale lakhon pravasi apne ghar laute.
